spec.description: 80x50x6 flat plate with central O20 thru and 4x O6 thru corner holes. Assumed: central bore is centred on plate (drawn symmetric on centrelines); 4 mounting holes form a symmetric rectangular pattern inset 8 from edges with 64x34 centre distances ((80-64)/2=8, (50-34)/2=8 consistent).
spec.name: mounting_plate

hole_inset.description: mounting hole centre distance from plate edge in X and Y (8 dim both sides)

hole_pitch_x.description: mounting hole centre-to-centre distance along X (64 dim)

hole_pitch_y.description: mounting hole centre-to-centre distance along Y (34 dim)
